text: We evaluated label smoothing on the weak supervision targets (label_smoothing = 0.05) in a weak-to-strong setup pairing a pythia-410m weak supervisor with a qwen2.5-7b strong student, averaged over 10 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.47 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.65, while the strong student trained on smoothed weak labels achieved transfer accuracy of 0.57 with a standard error of 0.01. This corresponds to a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.54 with a standard error of 0.02, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.47. The gain over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the direction of the effect is supported by these 10 seeds, though the margin is modest and only the point estimate for the baseline is available, with no reported uncertainty for it. Results are limited to this single model pair, smoothing value, and task setup, so generalization to other configurations remains untested.
